title: The metrology hole: no calibration, no absolute units, no comparability

quotes.quote: papers on luminescence-based detection methods rarely report on light signals in absolute numbers of photons, and never report on detection limits (LOD) in units of the density of photon emission rate, thus precluding any direct sensitivity comparison
UPE is still more of a technical curiosity than a reliable biomarker in the absence of standardization
the absence of standardized protocols for clinical measurement
quotes.source: listed among key experimental constraints — Sá 2026, `W7165757820`

what_would_settle_it: the calibration chain the field lacks already exists in single-photon radiometry — sub-100 fW detector calibration (Porrovecchio 2016, Metrologia, `curated/`) and free-running single-photon-detector efficiency metrology (López 2020, EPJ Quantum Technology, `curated/`) are solved problems in the metrology community, which the field map shows has **zero bibliographic contact** with the UPE literature. Bridging that gap is the most concrete, most fundable agenda item: reference materials, shared dark-count/QE reporting standards, and one inter-laboratory comparison would convert decades of archived counts-per-second into comparable science.

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Known oxidative pathways (ROS-driven lipid/protein oxidation producing triplet carbonyls and singlet oxygen) account for the dominant fraction of spontaneous UPE intensity in aerobic, non-photosynthetic cells (380–700 nm)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Fraction of band-integrated emission removed by targeted pathway perturbation, with spectral consistency check

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: (Null family) Under optical-only coupling, emitted UPE produces no receiver-side biological response above chance in any validated preparation
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Receiver-response effect size under optical-only coupling vs sham, blinded, with measured transmitted flux

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: UV-band emission from dividing cells increases mitosis rate in optically coupled detector cell populations (mitogenetic radiation), in at least one reproducible preparation
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Difference in division/budding rate, detector vs sham, with window transmission spectrum reported

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: At least one non-chemical, non-electrical cell-to-cell influence is mediated by emitted photons, demonstrable under optical-only coupling in a defined preparation
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Pre-registered replication of the strongest candidate (Musumeci 1999 yeast protocol) with transmitted-flux measurement; window material must be specified

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: UPE from at least one biological system carries a non-classical or partially coherent optical signature (umbrella claim; see operational sub-claims H2.g2, H2.sq)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Per sub-claim; umbrella retained only as evidence pool

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Second-order coherence g2(0) of UPE from a defined preparation deviates from 1 beyond detector artifacts
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: g2(0) with characterized dead-time/afterpulse correction and stated integration time at 10–100 cps

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: UPE photocount distributions from defined preparations are better fit by squeezed-state models than by classical mixtures, with model-comparison statistics
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Pre-registered model comparison (AIC/Bayes) on raw photocount time series with detector model included

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Delayed-luminescence decay parameters predict an external quality/physiology criterion out-of-sample in at least one matrix (defined instrument + excitation protocol)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: AUC / prediction-error vs baseline, blinded, pre-registered; excitation protocol fully specified

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Intracranial UPE intensity co-varies with neural activity beyond global metabolic rate in at least one preparation (slice or in vivo, invasive measurement)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Partial correlation of UPE with electrophysiological activity controlling oxygen consumption, same preparation

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Cytoskeletal or myelinated structures guide biological photons with transport efficiency materially above unguided tissue propagation (mechanism claim serving H5/H6, not their rival)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Direct transport measurement with external light injection in the candidate structure

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Surface UPE adds incremental predictive power for a defined systemic state (oxidative-stress criterion) beyond skin temperature, perfusion and environment, in humans
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: ΔAUC / partial R² over covariate-only model, blinded, test-retest reliability reported

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Seed/plant autoluminescence predicts vigour, stress state or product quality out-of-sample beyond standard assays in at least one crop/matrix
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Blinded field/greenhouse validation with pre-registered endpoints (the Frontiers 2025–26 line's own ask)

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Interfacial/structured water in cells materially alters UPE generation or storage relative to bulk-water chemistry (scoped to UPE-relevant observables)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: A named UPE observable that differs between bulk and interfacial preparations under matched chemistry

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: UPE spectral distribution carries state-specific information beyond total intensity (measurement-feature claim feeding H3/H8/H9)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: State discrimination from band ratios vs intensity-only, same instrument; requires <50 nm resolution capability that currently does not exist

registry_claims_at_stake.claim: Mental states or directed intention modulate human surface UPE beyond the physiological covariates they engage (overlaps H6 conceptually; kept for the anomalous-claims record)
registry_claims_at_stake.estimand: Mediation analysis with covariate recording; pre-registered; artifact-first design

instructions_to_engine: Propose falsifiable hypotheses that ADVANCE this question. A hypothesis that merely restates a registry claim scores zero for novelty; a hypothesis that cannot be measured with a named instrument scores zero for usefulness. Ground every claim in works retrieved through the corpus API, cite them by work_id, and state the measurement that would settle it.
